status: PROPOSAL ONLY; current comparison contracts remain unchanged
purpose: Permit prospectively qualified useful-task quality comparisons when complete provider usage is unavailable; do not infer cost, efficiency or token savings.

consequential_review.trigger: Current original-counter completeness gate blocks quality comparison although pinned upstream evaluators separate native rewards from optional usage.
consequential_review.source_lead_verdict: Astra source review supports a bounded quality-only amendment proposal; this is not family consensus or run admission.

primary_findings.claim: Harbor AgentContext input/cache/output/cost totals may be None independently of native verifier reward.
TrialResult retains agent context, verifier result and exception info separately. Its total helper sums available contexts/fields; numeric aggregate does not prove complete attempt coverage.
Job reward and exception aggregation precede separate optional usage aggregation; a partial numeric aggregate is not accepted complete usage.

The deterministic string matcher scores completion against target without consulting usage. Empty completion carries a no_response reason even when its value is CORRECT; preserve reason and disposition under the frozen oracle.
Inspect ModelOutput usage defaults to None; optional cache components retain distinct scope.

proposed_changes: Before any results, record a per-job prospective amendment to the exact shared and affected job contracts, with numeric quality rule and a two-family exact-head read.

An admitted quality-only run may retain complete-provider usage as null and observed partial native counters with explicit scope/coverage; unknown values are never zero, estimates, extrapolation or complete totals.
Cost, efficiency, savings, token-feature adoption and an unknown-token tiebreak remain HOLD. A quality tie retains the existing baseline; missing usage cannot qualify a challenger.
Use only the frozen maintained evaluator/oracle. Retain original per-attempt outcomes and no-response/refusal/timeout dispositions; upstream success alone cannot override the frozen quality rule.

For coding, retain the existing no-task-loss and at-least-one-task-improvement quality requirements. Prospectively specify all challenger ordering/tie rules before admission; no unknown-usage ranking.
Counter availability must not be used to infer actual task/client/route/model/effort/helper delivery. Those independent treatment identities remain required.

Keep runtime/helper/SDK retry policies, failure-vs-infrastructure classification, deadlines, recovery, limits and budget enforcement separately qualified. This proposal does not admit opaque or unenforced budgets; an uncapped study needs its own explicit prospective amendment.

Preserve owner pool/window allocation, task/oracle binding, original sealed terms, negative controls, images/network/lifecycle, first-party activation and no-prompt/no-credential-copy acceptance. Missing any required non-usage gate still prevents freeze.

required_reads.codex_root_exact_head: source proposal only; no changed contract admitted

preserved_failures.recovery: Discover maintained JSON path with rg --files; read shared-execution-contract.json unchanged.

next_action: Seek both-family exact-head proposal reads; if accepted, prepare explicit per-job/shared deltas and a new source-bound preregistration before any freeze.
